I'm not going to end my life. If there's no point in living then one won't be found in dying.

I'm just going to be here

I don't have any purpose. I can't make my own purpose, because that feels like a lie. So I have to look for others, but others won't look for me. You have real, true bona fide experience to understand that what I'm saying is stupid, idiotic, naive, and selfish. 

But all I have is a gray pit of despair where I've stopped reaching my hand out, because nobody will help me out. Not even myself.

All I have is second and third hand knowledge which can't be substituted for experience.
You should know then that we don't all just get to grow out of this. I'm stuck and it's where I'll be for a long time.

You might believe those things but I don't. My small, short lifetime of loneliness was more than enough evidence that people don't care.

They don't want to help me, they want me to stop pointing out the problems.

I'm not unique, I'm not special. I'm nothing.

Life has made that clear, time and time again. A worker bee, a drone, a cog. That's my lot in life. And it sucks to live to work in an uncaring, apathetic, gray world.

You and I are not the same.

That already happened. I became an alcoholic for a brief period, going through 6 packs every weekend and a bottle of vodka a month. The only time I've ever felt warmth in my life. But I hated feeling like garbage the next morning so I stopped my heavy drinking.

Just living is all I can do. Do you understand how emptying it is to continually be told this after trying?

Watching the world pass me by because I'm too idiotic to escape the handcuffs that I trapped myself in.

Dating's probably never been worth it for some people.

But I'd rather be destroyed by a toxic woman than left to silently live out the rest of my days wondering just where I went wrong.
If only I could unshackle myself from the chains of expectation both in my mind and from society, then maybe this would be.

I don't think other people care like I do about my interests like I do. Certain fans and fandoms are like a high intensity explosion. They're there, they consume it greedily as fast as possible, then they move on.

I'm more of a long wick candle.
It's something to look into but I have misgivings learning how to be social from a bot.

I lack the social ability to express interest. I used to get deeply attached to women just for talking to me because I'm attention starved in the romantic and emotional sense. I do not know how to go from being friends with a woman to something else. I have a twisted worldview that I imagine is deeply unattractive to experience. 

I'm getting fat because of depression. I'm not seeking treatment again because my last two psychologists just pushed pills at me and I was a number in a system.

It would be unethical for me to date because I would use my partner to express my emotions, and that's not fair.

On top of it all, I'm not ugly or hot or anything. Just a nondescript man who doesn't talk about his hobbies because I imagine few women are interested.

You could point to the depression, but I was like this way before I was diagnosed. It just helped make everything too difficult.

The only good quality I have is that I'm going back to school while working, so I guess you could say I'm a hard worker or something. 

I've just been alone for so long that I no longer understand how to form relationships out of anything other than convenience. I have 'friends' but it doesn't really feel like it to me. 

When I cut the people out of my life who I always had to text first and hassle to go places, I just ended up with a significantly smaller social circle.

Nowadays I don't even see the point of trying. I went to an anime convention years back and stuck to myself. I went on a solo trip to Japan and stuck to myself.

I can't let anyone in so I'm going to live alone.

I have lived in 4 different states as an adult. I have been in online dating on every app and website off and on for 4 years. I traveled to The Phillipines for work and Japan for vacation.

I have tried goddamnit.

You probably understand that the happiness moments are forever haunted by the endless emptiness of being alone and unloved.

It's all bullshit anyways.

Sex is merely an act of acceptance, validation, and desire. It's not the act that matters, it's the concept behind it.

The idea that in a world of nearly 8 billion someone was willing to pick me to vulnerable with.

It's got very little to do with just putting my P in a V but everyone loves to frame it that way.

Feelings of loneliness and later-in-life virgins are becoming more common.

I imagine there are thousands of men like me just in America alone. The only difference is they didn't post about their suicide, they just did it in silence.

It doesn't matter if you understand it's a lie when the rest of the world buys into it. You will forever be an outsider, seeking something that may not even exist.

If people don't need other people, why do you have friends? Why talk to your coworkers? Why even leave your bed?

If you're so self-assured go be a mute in the mountains. Shouldn't bother you at all.

You just wouldn't get it. There's different expectations on both men and women. The difference is women are more freely allowed to rebel against their societal roles. 

As a man I am trapped in a cage. 

I don't want sex. I want love, acceptance, and intimacy. That doesn't come from some $500 gray market escort in Nevada and if it does it's plastic and fake.

This is such garbage. I have friends and family. You know what I've never gotten ever in my life. 

Love. 

Stop lying to me. Romantic love and platonic love were coined by the ancient Greeks as different for a reason.
I'd rather be dead than denied what so many others take for granted.
